nodes.label: Portfolio Photo ph-0001: Living Room Interior After Renovation
nodes.description: Interior renovation photography of a completed modern living room. Shows a furnished apartment living area with grey sofa, wall-mounted TV, white Scandinavian-style TV cabinet, laminate wood flooring, track lighting on ceiling, pink/beige drape curtains, and a large panoramic window with a high-rise city view. Neutral grey-beige color palette. Stage: after renovation (fully furnished and decorated). Location type: interior. Construction work type: residential apartment full renovation / interior fit-out. Photography quality: professional, well-lit, wide-angle shot with natural light from window.

nodes.label: Portfolio Photo ph-0002: Open-Plan Kitchen-Dining Room Interior After Renovation
nodes.description: Interior renovation photography of a completed modern open-plan kitchen and dining room. Shows white handleless flat-front kitchen cabinets with dark countertop, built-in oven and microwave, dark backsplash, wooden dining table with grey velvet chairs set for four, wall-mounted TV on beige accent wall, white TV cabinet, track lighting, and wood-effect laminate flooring. Warm neutral beige-grey palette. Stage: after renovation (fully furnished and styled). Location type: interior. Construction work type: residential apartment full renovation / interior fit-out including kitchen installation. Photography quality: professional, well-composed wide-angle, balanced artificial and natural lighting.
